title: DAY 13/90
COLUMNS
scenes.sub: Week 3 starts: when does a column buckle?
scenes.voice: Day thirteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge. Week three starts now, ninety six days to GATE. Today we close strength of materials.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is strength of materials. Our topic: columns and energy methods, the last big piece of the subject.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover Euler's buckling load, end conditions and effective length, strain energy with Castigliano's theorem, and strain gauges with rosettes.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Euler load is pi squared E I over effective length squared. Fix both ends: four times the pinned load. Fixed and free: only one quarter.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Today's test opens from seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 12 Toppers
scenes.voice: Week two test toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo tops again with twenty point six six out of thirty. Rajeev Kumar takes rank two, and Akshay W holds rank three. Congratulations!
